events.description: Establishment of 3D axes and rendering of multiple individual oscillating waves of different spectral colors (red to violet) propagating along the x-axis.
events.clip_query: Multiple colored 3D waves propagating along an axis

events.description: The individual spectral waves are combined/averaged to form a single complex wave (the MeanWave) representing the superposition of white light.
events.clip_query: A single complex white wave formed by summing multiple colored waves

events.description: A vector field is overlaid on the wave, showing electric field vectors oscillating along the propagation path.
events.clip_query: Vector field arrows oscillating along a 3D wave path
